content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Rajkot
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Rajkot is a Government of India institute in Rajkot, Gujarat. Its letterhead calls it an Institute of National Importance under PMSSY, MoHFW. These posts are in its Viral Research and Diagnostic Laboratory (VRDL) at Village Para Pipaliya, Khanderi, Rajkot, Gujarat 360110. The Principal Investigator of the project is Dr. (Col) Ashwini Agarwal of the Department of Microbiology.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 2 posts in total. According to the notice, the number of posts may be increased or decreased as per the directions of the funding agency and the requirements of the project. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Preference to the candidate having 5 years of experience in Microbiology work. Knowledge of computer application or business intelligence tools/data management. Training of virology or molecular techniques obtained will be preferred. Preference will be given to those having previous work experience in molecular lab set up. He/ She should have basic knowledge of computers. The age limit is up to 35 years for both the Laboratory Technician and the Multi-tasking Staff post. The cut-off date for age, educational qualification and experience is the last date of submission of application, 30 November 2026. The application form also asks for the age as on 30 November 2026. Qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline/field and from a recognized institution/organization. Experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. The Principal Investigator may relax or alter the qualification, experience and other terms and conditions at his discretion. Candidates are responsible for making sure they meet the prescribed qualification and experience. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Laboratory Technician: Rs 28000 + HRA, with increments as admissible as per DST Norms. HRA, if admissible under the funding agency's guidelines, will be paid at the rate for Rajkot city (Class 'Y'). Multi-tasking Staff: Rs. 18000, consolidated without any allowances. The appointee is not a regular employee of AIIMS Rajkot or the Government of India. He or she is not entitled to any other financial or non-financial benefits or facilities, or to any special allowances, beyond the fixed consolidated emoluments prescribed by the funding agency. The posts are purely on contract for an externally funded research project. The person engaged will have no claim at any time to a regular post at AIIMS Rajkot, or to continued service in the same or any other project. The assignment is purely temporary for 11 months. It can be extended depending on the candidate's performance, continuation of the scheme and the budget grant from the funding agency. The Principal Investigator may also extend or curtail it at his discretion. The contract ends automatically when the stipulated time is over. It ends earlier if the funding agency withdraws support. Either side can end it at any time with 30 days' notice or salary in lieu of notice. Leave follows the Leave Policy of AIIMS Rajkot for project staff, as amended from time to time. The institute will not provide a hostel or any other accommodation.

Attach one set of self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below. Submit a soft copy of the application, with scanned copies of the attachments, through the Google Form at https://forms.gle/jN2WTanD4sd6GtrT8 by 30 November 2026 till 5 PM. If you apply for both posts, submit a separate application for each post. On 10 December 2026, bring the application and the documents to the written test and interview. Keep the original documents with you for verification. For document verification, bring a physical copy of the form and all documents, with xerox copies and the originals. The institute will not be responsible if a candidate fails to submit the online application through the Google Form within the prescribed date and time, for whatever reason. Applications that are incomplete, unsigned or not in the prescribed format, and those that do not meet the essential criteria, are likely to be summarily rejected. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: For both posts, selection has three stages: screening of the applications, an MCQ-based written test, and an interview. Selection is based purely on merit. Screening: A screening committee will check all the applications received. Written test: An MCQ-based written test. Candidates with the highest marks are called to the interview, up to six (6) candidates per available post. Interview: The final merit is worked out with a weightage of 80% for the written exam and 20% for the interview. Date and reporting: 10 December 2026, reporting time 9 AM, at Research Cell, Academic block, 3rd Floor, AIIMS Rajkot. What to bring: The documents listed above, in original. Persons working in a Government or Public Sector undertaking, or in any other research project at AIIMS Rajkot, should produce a "No Objection Certificate" at the interview. No request to change the date of the interview will be entertained, and no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Meeting the essential qualification or experience does not guarantee selection. The selection committee's decision is final, and no representation will be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Rajkot Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Laboratory Technician and 1 Multi-tasking Staff. The number may be increased or decreased as per the funding agency's directions and the needs of the project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Rajkot Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026 till 5 PM. The application must be submitted through the Google Form by then.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the AIIMS Rajkot Laboratory Technician post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is "B. Sc. /Intermediate with diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology or High School with 5 years Lab. Experience." Preference goes to candidates with 5 years of experience in Microbiology work.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the AIIMS Rajkot Multi-tasking Staff post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is High School /Matric / equivalent from a recognized board. Previous work experience in a molecular lab set-up and basic computer knowledge are desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AIIMS Rajkot Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 35 years for both posts, counted on the last date of application, 30 November 2026. SC/ST candidates get up to 5 years of relaxation and OBC candidates up to 3 years. PwBD candidates get 10, 13 or 15 years (General, OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the AIIMS Rajkot Laboratory Technician and Multi-tasking Staff?
faq.answer: The Laboratory Technician gets Rs 28000 + HRA, with increments as admissible as per DST Norms. The Multi-tasking Staff gets Rs. 18000, consolidated without any allowances.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the pay at AIIMS Rajkot?
faq.answer: HRA is paid only to the Laboratory Technician. It is paid if admissible under the funding agency's guidelines, at the rate for Rajkot city (Class 'Y'). The Multi-tasking Staff pay of Rs. 18000 is consolidated without any allowances.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for AIIMS Rajkot Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in and sign the application form printed in the notice. Then submit its scanned copy, with scanned documents, through the Google Form by 30 November 2026, 5 PM. Bring the form and the original documents to the written test and interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process and when is the interview?
faq.answer: Applications are screened first. Then comes an MCQ-based written test, and up to six candidates per post are called for an interview. The final merit uses 80% written test and 20% interview weightage. The written test and interview are on 10 December 2026 at 9 AM at Research Cell, Academic block, 3rd Floor, AIIMS Rajkot.

faq.question: Q10. Is the AIIMS Rajkot project post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely on contract for 11 months in an externally funded research project and can be extended. The person engaged has no claim to any regular post at AIIMS Rajkot.
